title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: How you feeling?
Well enough to ask a question about collusion in your chat today lol
I gave a great answer to that question
When you responded I was like “shit, he ain’t fucking around here.”
I made all that shit up
Wait, really? Lol
No lol
For a second, I believed you haha
It cracked me up to say that
You should see all the comments Jeff Moss sends me
At least 20
On the live chats?
Or just emails?
Either way, the guy is a troll
Sorry, got cut off by a phone call
He comments in the live chat under fake names, oftentimes with names like “Petey Cruiser”
(PT Cruiser) = The car I was driving when I got a DUI
I honestly think it’s funny. Sometimes I approve them if it’s a random Tigers question and it’s him, just giving him a little taste
He’s still a scumbag.
I was tempted to comment as Greg G. “Are you any good at Words with Friends?”
Lol

So I have been working for Fox Sports Detroit a bit since November, helping out on Pistons and Red Wings games from both the home and road. Today I just posted something to the Tigers Facebook page that was meant for FSD. It was up for nearly 30 minutes.
So that’s no ideal lol

Emphasized “So I have been working for Fox Sports Detroit a bit since November, helping out on Pistons and Red Wings games from both the home and road. Today I just posted something to the Tigers Facebook page that was meant for FSD. It was up for nearly 30 minutes.”
Omg lol
Not good to do that on the same day I interviewed for the social media coordinator job
Oh did you now
You idiot
Yes, I’m well aware of that at the moment haha
Who did you interview with?
Just Mac. It was just a phone interview, but I’m hoping I move on to the in-person one in the next couple weeks
You interviewing with Mac
Yeah, but I’d rather avoid any fuck ups lol
No, I’m saying, the fact you have to interview with Mac
Mac is a bum, (my opinion)
Why do you say that? There’s certainly plenty to be upset about, just curious what your reasoning is
